page.content:
Director and composer of Halloween (1978).

How John Carpenter connects

  • Topic: Halloween — John Carpenter created Halloween as director, co-writer, and composer.
  • Work: Halloween (1978) — Carpenter directed and scored Halloween (1978).
  • Concept: The Shape — Carpenter designed Michael as the Shape rather than a talkative killer.

What is John Carpenter?

John Carpenter directed, co-wrote, and scored Halloween (1978), establishing the Shape, the piano-theme stinger, and the suburban-stalker grammar later slashers copied.

Key threads lead to Halloween, Halloween (1978) and The Shape.
